title: Flatten, trim, drop blanks, de-duplicate and sort case-insensitively
contract: Flattens, trims each value, drops nulls and values blank after trimming, removes case-insensitive duplicates keeping the first occurrence, and sorts with String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER. Null outer and inner lists are empty.
notShownInJavadoc: first case variant is the one kept
case-insensitive sort differs from natural sort
